findings.description: The woman's upper body rises directly out of the cowl area in front of the windshield, between the hood and the glass, with the driver-side A-pillar and door mirror behind/right of her. She cannot be standing beside the car: the front fender side panel and woodgrain trim directly below her crossed arms are fully visible and unoccluded, so there is no place for her legs/lower torso except inside the solid hood/engine-bay volume. Her body effectively clips through the car body while her arms rest on the hood. The impossible placement persists unchanged through the whole camera push-in (clearly visible at 00:00, 00:02, 00:05 and 00:08).
